titleSq: Tokë në shitje në Shkabaj, Prishtinë
titleEn: Land for sale in Shkabaj, Prishtina
descriptionSq: Ofrohet per shitje truall me siperfaqe 72 ari, me lokacion ne Shkabaj, Prishtine.
Trualli ka infrastrukture te plote, qasje ne rruge, ujesjelles, kanalizim, si dhe lidhje me energji elektrike, dhe eshte i pershtatshem per ndertime te uleta, depo apo fabrika.
I pajisur me flete poseduese dhe kontrata behet tek noteri.
Trualli ndodhet ne nje zone me potencial zhvillimi.
descriptionEn: A plot of 72 ares is offered for sale, located in Shkabaj, Prishtina.
The plot has full infrastructure, road access, water supply, sewerage, as well as a connection to electricity, and is suitable for low-rise buildings, warehouses or factories.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The plot is located in an area with development potential.
